title: プログラミング基礎Ⅰ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Programming Basics I
educationalGoal: Students will learn the foundations of the C programming language, as computer programs are essential for developing robots, particularly for implementing motion control and environmental information acquisition.
advice: This is a basic course in the C programming language. We will cover the following topics: 1. Creating and running a computer program 2. Input and output 3. Variables 4. Expressions and operators 5. Conditional branching 6. Iteration 7. Arrays 8. Functions Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to bring their own laptop computers for use in exercises. Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class, as the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.

activityGoals.body: Understand the behavior of a basic C program that includes input/output and create such a program.

Understand the behavior of a basic C program that includes iteration and create such a program.
Understand the behavior of a basic C program that includes an array and create such a program.
Understand the behavior of a basic C program that includes a user-defined function and create such a program.
